post_1.title: The Architecture of this Blog
paragraphs: Welcome to the digital log. This specific page is built using a strict MVC-like pattern to ensure code maintainability.
Instead of hardcoding text into HTML, we are pulling this data from a structured JSON file, acting as our database.
